course.title: Enterprise Data Readiness for AI
course.start: A leader and a data or IT colleague from one organisation. No coding needed for leaders. Teams should be comfortable with spreadsheets and databases.
course.end: A scored baseline, a tested search over the organisation's own documents, and a twelve-month plan presented as a board paper.

modules: Use cases, data needs and a scored baseline.
Parse documents, search by meaning, test and secure the search.
Pipelines, privacy law, hosting, cost and licences.
Roles, policy, risk and the twelve-month plan.

levels_guide: Done by individuals when needed. Nothing written down. Different answers from different people.
A person's account only. No documents.
Some written practice in some places. Not applied across the organisation.
A document or list that covers part of the organisation, with gaps you can name.
A standard exists and most units know it. Owners are named. Gaps are known.
An approved policy, a complete list, a named owner, one report that uses them.
The standard is measured. Someone reviews the numbers and acts on them.
Monthly figures, a log of actions, minutes showing decisions.
The measures drive regular improvement. Changes are tested before they are rolled out.
A year of trend data and a record of improvements made from it.
